input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Explore run: build mann-kendall-trend, the eighteenth research-algorithm tool (Mann-Kendall test, Sen's slope, autocorrelation corrections, seasonal Kendall with Hirsch-Slack covariance, homogeneity test).
errors: First size simulation used a float LCG (s*1103515245 overflows 2^53) and gave degenerate 0%/9% rates; replaced with the mulberry32 generator the tests use.
normPpf's Halley step lost precision for p = 1e-10 (1 - normSf(x) cancels); fixed by using normSf(-x) for x < 0.

doc_friction.issue: The `PY=$(python3 platform/ci/pyenv.py ...)` route was not needed; a plain `python3 -m venv` plus pip install of numpy/scipy/pymannkendall worked in about a minute, which cloud-session.md also mentions as the fallback.
Takes several minutes; piping it through `| tail` inside a 120 s tool call hides all progress until it finishes, so start it with run_in_background from the outset.

deviations.why: The spec asks for tests against a published or independently computed reference; for the default Yue-Wang correction pymannkendall's default is itself the problem, so the reference for the default is the paper's AR(1) formula written out independently in eval/reference.py, and pymannkendall's all-lag version is matched by a separate helper.
deviations.did: Matched every other statistic to pymannkendall/scipy and the default to an independent formula, plus a seeded size simulation (eval/size-simulation.json) that the page's quoted numbers are tested against.
deviations.result: 38 tests pass; page claims tied to the simulation file by page.test.mjs.

notes: Idea: a Mann-Kendall / Sen's slope / seasonal Kendall tool for environmental trend testing, no venture covered it. Finding: in seeded simulation (1,000 AR(1) series per cell) pymannkendall 1.4.3's default yue_wang_modification_test (all lags summed) calls a trend in 45-51% of trend-free series including white noise; confirmed with the package itself (300 white-noise series, n=100: 44%; lag=1: 8%). Default here is Yue-Wang AR(1) (5-9% for phi<=0.6). Hamed-Rao all-lag screen 19% and TFPW 40% at phi=0.6, n=100. Example: USGS Potomac at Little Falls; on the withdrawal-adjusted record the independent seasonal test says p=0.0039 increasing, the Hirsch-Slack covariance p=0.113. No upstream issue was filed (outward-facing; left to the owner).
